environment.external_gpu_activity: not_excluded; other cooperating jobs on other cards

correctness.operation: out-of-place contiguous row-major FP32 transpose: B[col*rows+row]=A[row*cols+col]
correctness.input_scope: one deterministic position-unique float32 input; repeated output checks are not independent random inputs
correctness.comparison: independent nested input-row/column CPU oracle; all final payload words bitwise checked, finite counts and guards verified
correctness.boundary_scope: small asymmetric/skinny cases, 63/64/65 boundaries and two large ragged shapes

measurement.timed_scope: default-stream events around 10 launches; may include device idle gaps during host submission
measurement.cache_policy: repeated addresses; no explicit application cache reset; runtime cache policy unknown
measurement.transfer_scope: allocation, initialization, transfers and file writes outside event intervals
measurement.throughput_scope: logical read+write bytes; not measured DRAM traffic
measurement.function_attribute_query: before each case's warmups and timing; runtime observations, not occupancy measurements
measurement.wave_size_note: MACA 3.5.3 headers alias waveSize to warpSize; one API observation
measurement.device_buffers: 64MiB input and 64MiB+256B output reused per process
measurement.analysis_unit: process, paired same-shape ratios of ten-batch medians; then median[min,max] over six processes
measurement.address_control_basis: frozen source reuses the two device allocations; no per-instruction address trace or physical DRAM-placement control
measurement.changed_factors: direct vs tiled jointly changes index arithmetic, CTA count, per-thread work, shared storage and barriers; padding also changes storage size/code generation

plan.analysis_unit: process; within-process same-shape ratios of ten-batch medians
plan.condition: only launch after all 57 sweep cases pass and device runtime fits its bound

trace_summary.scope: observed mcTracer 3.5.3 export; trace-captured execution only
trace_summary.warmup_assignment: caller-specified initial launches then warmups ordered by raw timestamp

recompiled_flag.scope: kernel-event descriptor flag, not a count of compilation operations

artifacts.public_projection: all 1140 timing batches, function/resource reports and raw trace durations; full output arrays/process metadata retained outside source

limitations: One physical C550 and SDK/compiler build; not a generic optimal-tile or portability claim.
Large ragged shapes received full correctness and exploratory timing, not the six-process performance confirmation.
Paired ratios measure whole implementation effects, not isolated coalescing or bank-conflict cost.
C500 bank documentation is only a prior; no C550 bank count/width/conflict-degree was identified.
Different static shared bytes do not establish actual occupancy; no validated occupancy/cache/DRAM counters collected.
Application performs no explicit data-cache reset; runtime cache policy remains unverified.
Trace duration units remain unverified; profiled timing is separate from unprofiled confirmation.
No in-place, arbitrary-stride, other-dtype or target-framework integration qualification.
